changelog:
**Remote YouTube trailers are now inserted into the real schedule.** Preview, manual-title and combined trailer modes use linked RemoteTrailers when no local trailer file exists. The schedule marks them as Trailer entries, reserves a bounded duration, and Wholphin resolves the fresh stream immediately before playback.

**Trailer discovery works for episodes and their series as well as films and collections.** The actual trailer endpoint was verified against the live Jellyfin library.
description: Lightweight virtual TV channels: deterministic schedules over your own library, tuned in via normal direct playback at the live position. No transcoding, no tuner emulation.
name: LiteTV Channels
overview: TV channels from your library, without transcoding.
